questions.q: What shape were the buildings meant to have?
questions.e: In the video: "u obliku potpunih trouglova od 19 spratova" — in the form of complete triangles of 19 floors.

questions.q: What was built instead of the triangles?
questions.e: In the video: "umesto toga napravljeni današnji poznati stepenasti soliteri" — instead, the famous stepped towers of today were built.
In the video: "zgrade u blokovima 61-64" — the buildings in blocks 61-64.

questions.q: What kind of architecture did the experiment leave behind?
questions.e: In the video: "u vidu jedinstvene brutalističke arhitekture" — in the form of unique brutalist architecture.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: zgrade u blokovima 61-64 *prvobitno* trebalo da budu

questions.e: Iseći — to cut off; isečene — cut down.

questions.q: Davno zaboravljena tajna Novog ___ jeste da su zgrade
questions.e: Tajna (of what?) takes the genitive: Novog Beograda.
The preposition u ("in") answering "where?" takes the locative pl.: u blokovima.
After obliku + potpunih the genitive pl. is needed: trouglova.
The phrase u vidu ("in the form of") takes the genitive: arhitekture.
